data_product_description: This dashboard shows dental activity data for England, helping providers review performance, monitor individual contracts and download data for analysis.
data_product_overview:
## Data Product Overview
There is a need for dental providers to be able to monitor their activity as a whole as well as the individual contracts within the provider and the performers within the individual contracts. This helps make sure they are providing the services they are commissioned to provide and maximise the benefit to patients.

To enable this, a dashboard is available within the eDEN system which allows users to access a range of dental data including detailed information extracted from the FP17.

The dashboard provides dental activity information at contract and performer level for a range of different metrics, allowing users to visualise data within the system and quickly download data relating to those metrics.
